description: The Surface Pro 3 is Microsoft's new 2-in-1 device. The lightweight, feature-rich device is heralded as the perfect blend between a laptop and a tablet, combining the advantages of both.   This Evaluation App is a beautiful survey application for Microsoft Belgium and Luxemburg to gauge for the experience of Surface Pro 3 users.  If you are interested in buying or testing a Surface Pro 3 or if you have not received a code from your contact person at Microsoft Belux, you can contact them at www.microsoft.com/surface/nl-be/support
